knowledge_scrolls.memory_zh: ……第七纪元残页：敌群踏过河滩时，木头会先于人类尖叫。箭，要从高处落下。
knowledge_scrolls.memory_en: Fragment of the 7th epoch: when the horde crosses the shallows, the wood screams before the men do. Arrows must fall from above.

knowledge_scrolls.memory_zh: ……粮仓失守那夜的记录：鼠群与霉变同至，守军学会了把食物抬离地面——以及把箭簇抬得更高。
knowledge_scrolls.memory_en: Record of the night the granary fell: rats and rot arrived together; the garrison learned to lift the food off the ground - and the bolt heads higher.

knowledge_scrolls.memory_zh: ……一位民夫的遗言被刻在辕木上：路要直，车要满。我走了一千趟，第一千零一趟交给你。
knowledge_scrolls.memory_en: A porter's last words carved into a shaft: roads straight, carts full. I walked it a thousand times; the thousand-and-first is yours.

knowledge_scrolls.memory_zh: ……烽火台灰烬里的值班表：每柱烟都是一个字，整夜的天空是一句话。读它的人不在了，话还在。
knowledge_scrolls.memory_en: A duty roster found in beacon ashes: each column of smoke was a word, the whole night sky a sentence. The reader is gone; the sentence stays.

_scroll_note: 知识残卷=系统『丢失的记忆碎片』（F-099：读残卷=恢复系统上一纪元的记忆）；同一科技节点至多 1 张（附录 F.3，Legacy.KnowledgeScrollBoard 执法）；relief_share 经 Legacy.StackingRule 单一咽喉与其它减免乘法叠加、总下限 50%
